Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. This card's [Your Turn] effect affects all of your Digimon with the [NSp] trait, not your opponent's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to prevent attacks by all of my Digimon with the [NSp] trait from being blocked by my opponent's Digimon that aren't affected by Digimon effects and have ?

Effect: [On Play] 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't suspend until the end of their turn.
[Your Turn] None of your [NSp] trait Digimon's attack targets can change.
